Motion: Eight phases of a stationary breathing loop on four planted paddle-limbs: closed gills; gills start widening; throat expands; chest lifts slightly; full breath; chest slowly lowers; gills settle; return toward pose 1. Retain exact head length and body length, do not turn into a different animal. Keep the fan-shaped tail completely visible.
Exactly 8 individually drawn chronological full-body poses on an invisible regular 4-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then second row. Landscape canvas 2:1, ideally1774x887. No cell crosses, cropped heads, tails or digits. Same individual and materials in every pose. Camera STRICT RIGHT-FACING ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE VIEW, no3/4, no turns, no isometric view.
Style: match the source's detailed crisp hand-painted pixel-game bitmap, readable organic texture and restrained highlights, no motion blur.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, preserve every fine appendage. If native transparency cannot be emitted, use perfectly flat pure#FF00FF magenta ONLY outside the subject. NO checkerboard pixels, white background, ground shadow, scenery, labels, text, border or UI. No generated code, no recolor filter, no interpolation or repeated pose. One complete creature per cell.
The albino version, if specified, is a newly drawn project adaptation, not a claim of an official albino model.
